licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the actual distribution: fraudulent license procurement, professional misconduct/negligence in practice, criminal convictions, reciprocal discipline from other jurisdictions or agencies, statutory/rule violations, CPE/peer-review compliance failures, unauthorized or improper practice (practicing without license, false names, firm noncompliance), physical/mental/substance impairment, and a residual fitness/general-conduct catch-all for items like child support noncompliance, discrimination refusal, and similar grounds that don't fit the prior eight.
